title: Boundary and simplex-collapse test for simplicial realization functors
statement: A model category means a complete and cocomplete category $\mathcal M$ with classes $C,F,W$ of cofibrations, fibrations and weak equivalences. The class $W$ is retract closed and satisfies two-out-of-three, and $(C,F\cap W)$ and $(C\cap W,F)$ are weak factorization systems with functorial factorizations. A weak factorization system consists of factorizations of every map into its two classes, each class being exactly the maps with the diagonal-lifting property against the other. Trivial means also in $W$; an object is cofibrant if its initial map is in $C$, and fibrant if its terminal map is in $F$. Universes may be enlarged. Use the simplicial sets, standard simplices, boundaries and weak homotopy equivalences of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Let $V:\mathrm{sSet}\to\mathcal M$ preserve all small colimits. If $V(\partial\Delta^n)\to V(\Delta^n)$ is a cofibration for every $n\geq0$, then $V$ sends every monomorphism to a cofibration. If, in addition, every collapse $V(\Delta^n)\to V(\Delta^0)$ induced by $[n]\to[0]$ is a weak equivalence, then $V$ sends every monomorphism that is a weak homotopy equivalence to a trivial cofibration and sends every weak homotopy equivalence to a weak equivalence. In particular it sends every horn inclusion to a trivial cofibration. If $V$ has a right adjoint, this is a Quillen adjunction.
